title: Building in vitro 3D human multicellular models of high-grade serous ovarian cancer
author: Malacrida, Pearce, et al.
materials: Human High Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer cells

steps.title: Prepare collagen‑fibroblast‑cancer mixture
steps.instruction: Mix collagen solution with primary omental fibroblasts and HGSOC malignant cells at a 1:1 ratio (use 1 × 10⁵ fibroblasts and 2.5 × 10⁵ cancer cells per gel) according to the collagen recipe given in the Materials section.

steps.title: Cast collagen gel in 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of the collagen‑cell mixture into each well of a 96‑well plate and incubate for at least 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow gelation.

steps.title: Transfer gel to 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Using a small spatula or spoon, gently detach each solidified gel from the 96‑well plate and place it into a 24‑well plate containing 1 mL of culture medium; change medium every second day.

substeps.instruction: Optional: add 50 µg/mL ascorbic acid to the medium every second day to boost extracellular matrix production.

steps.title: Embed collagen gel in adipocyte gel (tri‑culture)
steps.instruction: Move an adipocyte gel (no medium) to the bottom of a 24‑well plate, quickly place the collagen gel on top, press gently with the plunger of a 1 mL syringe, then add 1 mL of culture medium to the well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the combined gels for 5–7 days before use; note that adipocyte gel viability declines after ~21 days.

steps.title: Prepare adhesive layer for tetra‑culture
steps.instruction: Create the collagen “adhesive” solution as described in Materials, dispense 20 µL onto the bottom of each well of a 96‑well plate, and place an adipocyte gel onto the adhesive.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at least 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to allow attachment.

steps.title: Plate fibroblasts onto adipocyte gel
steps.instruction: From an 80–90 % confluent fibroblast flask, aspirate medium, wash with 1× DPBS, detach with trypsin, count cells, and plate 4 × 10⁴ fibroblasts in 100 µL of culture medium onto each adipocyte gel.

steps.title: Plate mesothelial cells onto fibroblast layer
steps.instruction: After the 2‑hour fibroblast incubation, wash with 1× DPBS, detach and count mesothelial cells, then plate 2 × 10⁵ mesothelial cells in 100 µL of culture medium on top of the fibroblast‑laden adipocyte gel.

steps.title: Add HGSOC cells to tetra‑culture
steps.instruction: Following the 24‑hour mesothelial incubation, aspirate medium, wash with 1× DPBS, detach and count malignant HGSOC cells, then replace the supernatant with 200 µL of HGSOC cells suspended in culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for another 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Transfer tetra‑culture to fresh plate
steps.instruction: Gently dislodge the completed tetra‑culture and move it to a new 24‑well plate containing 1 mL of culture medium per well for downstream experiments.

description: The protocol below describes the isolation and construction of human in-vitro multicellular models using fresh omental tissue and high-grade serous ovarian cancer, HGSOC, malignant cell lines. However, we think this protocol could be used to build similar tissues for other cancers especially those that develop omental metastases such as colorectal cancers. The omental tissue used in this protocol comes from a surgical or diagnostic biopsy that is surplus to requirements. Approval by a UK national review board and written consent from patients were obtained (HTA license number 12199. REC no: 10/H0304/14).
